features.title: Fixed-step deterministic sim core
acceptance: The sim state is one plain JSON-serializable object advanced by step(state, world, input) at a fixed 60 Hz
A seeded RNG (mulberry32) lives in the state; src/sim and src/world never call Math.random or Date
The same seed and inputs give an identical state hash after 600 ticks; a sim test proves it
src/sim imports nothing from the DOM, WebGL or three.js renderer code and runs in Node
features.evidence: tests/sim/core.test.ts (determinism hash, JSON round trip, rng, no nondeterministic APIs); commit feat(M1-01)

features.title: Box and ramp collision world
acceptance: Solids are axis-aligned boxes or ramps (a box whose top slopes along one axis) indexed in a 4 m uniform grid
Queries: box overlap, ground height under a point, and a raycast returning distance and normal of the first hit
Unit tests cover box overlap, ramp surface height, ray hits on boxes and ramps, and misses
features.evidence: tests/sim/geom.test.ts (overlap, ramp height, groundAt, raycast boxes/ramps/misses); commit feat(M1-02)

features.title: AABB carving
acceptance: carve(solids, box) replaces every overlapped solid with up to 6 boxes covering its remainder
Unit tests: a tunnel carved through a block leaves walls, floor and ceiling around an empty interior, and volume is conserved minus the carved part
features.evidence: tests/sim/geom.test.ts carving suite (tunnel, room, volume); commit feat(M1-03)

features.title: Player kinematics: jog, sprint, crouch, gravity, stairs
acceptance: Jog 3.2, sprint 7.0 and crouch 1.6 m/s on flat ground within 3% once accelerated
Walls stop the player with no tunnelling at sprint speed or in a 30 m/s fall
Steps up to 0.45 m are climbed automatically; a 30-degree stair ramp is climbed at jog speed and descended without leaving the ground
Crouching under a 1.3 m ceiling works and standing up there is refused
features.evidence: tests/sim/kinematics.test.ts (speeds, walls, 30 m/s landing, step-up 0.45, 30-degree stairs both ways, crouch ceiling); commit feat(M1-04)

features.title: Jump
acceptance: Standing jump apex is between 0.6 and 0.7 m (U-004: more vertical)
A running jump at sprint clears a 4.5 m gap and lands on the far side; a 5.2 m gap is not cleared to a standing landing

features.evidence: tests/sim/jump.test.ts (apex 0.6-0.7, 4.5 clears, 5.2 fails, air control, no air speed-up); commit feat(M1-05)

features.title: Space hops and the hand mantle

Gripping a ledge lip and pulling up (W or Space) with the body high enough mantles onto the top when there is room for a crouched body
A standing grab reaches ledge lips up to 2.3 m and a jump up to 2.8 m, so 2.4 m ledges are climbable and a 3.0 m lip needs a run-up
Sim tests cover hops, refusals and hand mantles
features.evidence: tests/sim/mantle.test.ts Space hops; tests/sim/grip.test.ts hand mantle (1.0-2.2 standing, 2.4 with jump, 3.0 refused); commit feat(M1-06)
